name: The Medina
tagline: Historic walled heart of old Tangier
description: A maze of narrow lanes, whitewashed houses and hidden riads within the old walls. Packed with cafes, artisans, small guesthouses and centuries of history, it is atmospheric and lively, though cramped and busy with visitors and traders throughout the day.
bestFor: Culture lovers and short-stay travellers who want to live inside the old city

name: The Kasbah
tagline: Hilltop citadel with sweeping sea views
description: Perched above the medina, the Kasbah is the old fortified quarter, quieter and more refined, with restored houses, boutique riads and stunning views across the Strait to Spain. Its steep lanes draw artists and those seeking calm and vistas.
bestFor: Creatives and quiet-seekers wanting views, charm and a peaceful old-town base

name: Ville Nouvelle (Boulevard Pasteur)
tagline: Modern city centre and business hub
description: The modern downtown around Boulevard Pasteur, with banks, shops, restaurants, coworking spaces and reliable internet. This is where most remote workers base themselves, enjoying comfortable flats, cafe culture and easy access to services and transport connections.
bestFor: Remote workers wanting reliable WiFi, coworking, cafes and everyday convenience

name: Malabata
tagline: Coastal district east of the bay
description: A greener, more modern residential area stretching east along the bay, with newer apartment blocks, hotels and sea-facing flats. Quieter and more spacious than the centre, it appeals to those wanting comfort, sea views and calm within reach of town.
bestFor: Longer-stay nomads seeking modern flats, sea views and a quieter setting
